cohort: 1934 preterm infants born between 2006 and 2016 to women with cephalic singleton pregnancies and planned vaginal delivery from 24 to 34 weeks' gestation
finding: Operative vaginal delivery (OVD) was not associated with non-optimal neurocognitive development at 2 years of corrected age for preterm singletons.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery (OVD) was not associated with non-optimal neurocognitive development at 2 years of corrected age for preterm singletons, compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery or cesarean delivery.
